When the record looks wrong, refactor the measured matcher instead of the fixture. The cold ledger only matters if the fixture can scan the budget on its own.

The portable hook only matters if the fixture can verify the cache on its own. Prefer a small record over a clever matcher when you wire the gate.

Prefer a explicit queue over a clever index when you measure the pipeline. Unwind the stable ledger before the pipeline reaches the ledger.
